objective: Qualify one genuinely unseen scalar-ODE forecast through horizon-aligned public evidence, a separately administered private evaluator, and an independent signed promotion decision.

task.selection_rule: The task and target schema are frozen before generation; the custodian commits the private capsule before the generator is released.
reuse_forbidden: any task or target values visible in prior model context

required: two identical fresh V5.3 replay hashes
passing final-refit recertification for every target horizon
public_evidence.candidate_selection: Candidate family is selected only on the chronological public development split.
public_evidence.final_refit: The selected family is locked, refit once on all public data, and the exact refit predictions are horizon-checked and registered.

required: PrivateScoreContractV53 frozen before private source access
private capsule created only on the custodian host
custodian host distinct from generator and coordinator
generator egress denied until prediction registration
external anchor receipt retained and independently verified
PrivateEvaluationRequestV53 bound to graph, registration, score contract, and capsule commitment
ExternalWorkerHostAttestationV53 from an independent host-management key
private_evaluation.feedback: One aggregate quality score and threshold result only; no target values, per-target errors, gradients, rankings, canary, or retry advice.

required: verified private run and threshold pass
promotion key distinct from custody, worker, and host-management keys

stop_conditions: any private value, canary, or private key reaches generator/coordinator storage
any public or private content hash differs
the V5 S4 gate is missing or stale
any signer key is unpinned, reused across authority roles, or invalid
any requested target horizon lacks complete V5.3 robustness evidence
the single private evaluation is consumed, fails, or times out
